command: name=$(cat -- "$1") || exit 1; [ -n "$name" ] || exit 0; case $name in */*|.*) exit 1;; esac; found=; for d in "$HOME/.icons" "${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/icons"; do [ -d "$d/$name" ] && found=1; done; IFS=:; for d in ${XDG_DATA_DIRS:-/usr/local/share:/usr/share}; do [ -d "$d/icons/$name" ] && found=1; done; [ -n "$found" ] || exit 0; [ "$(gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface icon-theme)" = "'$name'" ] && exit 0; exec gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.interface icon-theme "$name"
